system.description:
EARTH INSIGHT REVELATION UTILITY
Tradition verdant
Cast 1 minute (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets one natural stone, earthen surface or exposed area of natural ground

You awaken the faint impressions retained by the land.
You receive a brief sensory impression of the most significant physical or spiritual disturbance that affected the target or occurred within 10 feet of it during the previous 24 hours.
The impression lasts no more than several seconds and may include vibration, pressure, sound, temperature, strong emotion or spiritual disturbance, and indistinct visual impressions where appropriate.
The land does not possess human understanding. It cannot answer questions, identify a creature by name or provide facts it could not physically or spiritually have experienced.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Read impressions up to 1 week old.
+2 PP: Increase the surrounding area to 30 feet.
+4 PP: Read impressions up to 1 month old.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
